tools.name: search_ms3
tools.purpose: Search stored Material-Sensor-Signal-System paths across the frozen corpus and expose linked evidence identifiers.

tools.name: trace_paths
tools.purpose: Return complete stored paths and linked article-evidence previews from the corpus or visible workspace papers.
tools.workspace_constraint: Requested paper identifiers must already be visible in the workspace.

tools.name: inspect_evidence
tools.purpose: Open exact article-evidence records with provenance and supported elements or relations.

citation_rule: Every paper-specific claim must cite an opened paper_id:E# article-evidence record; mechanism identifiers route retrieval but are not final evidence.
insufficient_evidence_rule: Use INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE when the opened database records do not support a requested claim.

post_run_audit.checks: Whether final paper-specific citations refer to article evidence opened during the run.
post_run_audit.does_not_check: Semantic entailment or overall answer correctness.
